title: From risk factors to individualized prediction: development and internal validation of a machine learning model for early identification of postoperative pneumonia after lung cancer surgery.
summary: A machine-learning model predicted postoperative pneumonia among 200 lung-surgery patients and used nested internal validation. The study reports an internally evaluated risk model; external validation remains needed.
ai_technology: Machine-learning model for postoperative pneumonia prediction
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Nested internal validation was reported in a cohort of 200 lung-surgery patients.
evidence.unknown: Small single-study cohort and internal validation only; external performance and clinical benefit remain unknown.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning model for postoperative pneumonia prediction

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
